claims.statement: KSeF was mandatory from 1 February 2026 for the largest businesses and from 1 April 2026 for most others, while firms at or below 10,000 PLN of monthly invoiced sales remain outside mandatory issuance until 2027; the government's 30 June status says production had operated stably without disruptions.
The Ministry of Finance provides a free iOS and Android KSeF mobile app that can issue invoices and corrections from any location, save drafts, and manage buyers.
inFakt advertises an invoicing plan at 4.99 PLN net per month with annual billing, unlimited documents, KSeF sending and retrieval, coworker access, technical support, integrations, and an API.

Comarch Mobile already supports both online KSeF issuance and offline issuance for lost connectivity or KSeF unavailability, including an offline certificate, QR evidence, ERP synchronization, and later statutory submission.

The official KSeF permission model allows a taxpayer to grant InvoiceRead or InvoiceWrite access to people or entities and supports indirect delegation, while warning that broad general permissions require caution.
KSeF authentication succeeds only while the authenticating party has an active permission in the chosen taxpayer context, and access tokens are automatically invalidated when that permission is lost.

Official offline24 rules let a taxpayer choose offline issuance but require transmission by the next business day after issuance; official KSeF-unavailability mode requires transmission by the next business day after the outage ends.

A third-party bridge can technically receive invoice permissions, but its operational access would remain nonexclusive and revocable by the taxpayer; whether target firms will grant and maintain that access contractually is not established.

The proposed field-to-KSeF handoff is replaceable rather than proprietary: the free Ministry app overlaps mobile issuance, inFakt supplies very low-priced KSeF plumbing, and Comarch Mobile already combines mobile offline issuance with ERP synchronization; any superior trade-specific job-evidence or cross-accounting reconciliation gap remains unproved.

Before the April rollout, KAS reported more than 345,000 issuing entities and 87 million invoices in two months, alongside nearly 180,000 phone conversations and more than 70,000 emails about KSeF; the same announcement describes free 24-hour KAS support and tax-office assistance.

No KSeF-use error sanctions apply for 2026; the official FAQ says monetary penalties can apply only to violations from 1 January 2027, reducing immediate compliance urgency during the validation year without removing the later obligation.

The production integration surface continued changing after launch: the official changelog records tightened XML validation, authentication and token changes, key rotation support, bug fixes, and new warning and export behavior through mid-2026, implying ongoing maintenance and regression-support work for any bridge.

No observed target-customer data quantifies the post-rollout frequency, staff time, cash-delay cost, or error cost of field rekeying, rejected invoices, reconciliation failures, or missed offline deadlines in Polish installation and mobile-service firms.

No signed letter of intent, preorder, paid pilot, or revealed-preference test establishes willingness to pay 149-699 PLN monthly or 2-5 PLN per reconciled invoice against free and low-priced substitutes.
No executed accounting-office referral agreement, field-service software integration agreement, channel revenue share, customer-acquisition cost, sales-cycle, or close-rate evidence was available.

Fully loaded contribution is unknown because there is no measured onboarding, mapping, failed-submission support, security, GDPR, tax-counsel, insurance, partner-share, storage, notification, or continuing schema-maintenance cost per customer or invoice.
No cohort or renewal evidence shows that field firms will keep using a separate bridge after KSeF onboarding stabilizes and accounting or field-service suites reach feature parity.

No taxpayer mandate, production credential, data-processing agreement, or integration right has been presented for the venture; a family-company testing relationship alone does not establish KSeF access.

No evidence shows that invoice failures can be lawfully pooled across customers into an anonymized proprietary corpus or that such a corpus would create a durable prediction advantage over official validation rules and incumbent telemetry.

It is untested whether tax-deadline support, credential incidents, and multiple accounting-package integrations can be operated within the founder's five-hours-per-day limit while retaining full-time employment.

contrary_evidence: The government reported stable production operation through 30 June 2026, so system instability is not evidenced as a persistent post-rollout problem.

The Ministry of Finance already offers a free mobile invoicing app, inFakt advertises broad KSeF handling for 4.99 PLN net per month, and Comarch Mobile already supports offline issuance plus ERP synchronization.
The taxpayer retains revocable permission control, so the proposed handoff is neither owned nor exclusive and can be reassigned to an incumbent.
The 2026 sanction holiday reduces the immediate compliance trigger during the period in which demand would need to be validated.
